Hi Ben —

We need Redwood to remove all assistant-generated artifacts for Acme Health (customer id: ACME-789) originating from the EU region. Scope: user prompts, assistant outputs, prompt logs, KV cache entries and any transient inference logs that may contain customer data. Time range: all artifacts created since 2024-01-01.

Please confirm:
- exact scope you will remove (object types + storage locations)
- planned date/time for the deletion job and expected completion SLA
- proof artifacts we will receive (manifest, checksums, ops run log)
- whether any backups or replication (cross-region snapshots) need separate handling

This is required for our internal compliance review and to meet obligations under our data processing addendum. I have attached the signed deletion request form.

Thanks —

Subject: Re: Request: removal of assistant-generated artifacts (ACME-789) — ops plan

Ben / team —

Thanks, Ben. Short plan below; this is an ops-led removal with Security oversight. I will own execution and delivery of proof.

Scope confirmed: prompts (indexed prompt logs), assistant outputs (model-generated files stored in s3 buckets tagged acme-789-eu), KV cache snapshots keyed to acme-789, inference diagnostic logs (retention buckets). We will not touch customer-managed backups held outside our platform unless explicitly requested.

Execution steps (summary):
1) Identification (T+0 to T+4h): enumerate object keys and DB rows using account tag acme-789, generate deletion manifest (CSV).
2) Staging & verification (T+4h to T+8h): snapshot manifest to internal audit bucket, run pre-delete dry-run to validate object counts.
3) Deletion window (scheduled): 2026-11-30 02:00–04:00 UTC — run deletion job J-20261130-ACME in read-only maintenance window to minimize write churn.
4) Post-delete verification (T+0 to T+6h after job): confirm object removals, run checksum comparison, produce ops_run_log and signed manifest.
5) Evidence handoff: manifest + ops_run_log + S3 object delete-records (where available). We'll redact any internal-only identifiers and provide hashed checksums for proof.

Rollbacks & safety: deletion is irreversible once completed; we will keep an internal retention snapshot for 30 days (encrypted, access-controlled) solely to support legal queries — that snapshot will be flagged for secure destruction after 30 days unless otherwise requested by Acme Health. If Acme requires zero-retention even at our side, that must be documented in an amendment.

Estimated SLA: completion within 72 hours from the scheduled run (includes verification). Required inputs from Acme: confirmation to proceed with the 11/30 window and acknowledgement of the internal 30-day hold for legal support (unless amended).

Attachments we will deliver: removal_manifest_20261130.csv, ops_run_log_20261130.txt. I will produce the initial manifest by 11/29 20:00 UTC for client review.

-Marissa
Senior Ops Engineer, Data Hygiene
Redwood Inference
